- **Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers/Bugwood_4** — shows darkened/blackened stem with some white mycelium, more consistent with the dark sooty coloration in the test image.
- **Phytophthora_Blight** — dark stem lesions but no powdery sporulation.
- **Sclerotinia, Southern_Blight** — white mycelium, not matching.

The test image shows distinctly dark (almost black) powdery sporulation at a stem junction — more consistent with Alternaria black mold than Botrytis gray mold, which produces lighter gray fluffy growth. The dark, sooty coating is the hallmark of Alternaria sporulation on stems.
